units.english: A Syndicate executive needs immediate yet comfortable transportation to attend an urgent meeting on <destination> by <date>. Payment is <payment>.
units.raw: description "A Syndicate executive needs immediate yet comfortable transportation to attend an urgent meeting on <destination> by <date>. Payment is <payment>."

units.english: The Syndicate executive rushes off your ship without even a goodbye, fancy briefcase in hand. You collect your payment of <payment>.
units.raw: dialog "The Syndicate executive rushes off your ship without even a goodbye, fancy briefcase in hand. You collect your payment of <payment>."

units.english: A team of <bunks> engineers needs transport to a corporate retreat on <stopovers>, after which they must return back to <origin> by <date>. They want a comfortable journey, so your ship must be outfitted suitably. Payment is <payment>.
units.raw: description "A team of <bunks> engineers needs transport to a corporate retreat on <stopovers>, after which they must return back to <origin> by <date>. They want a comfortable journey, so your ship must be outfitted suitably. Payment is <payment>."

units.english: For days your ship has played host to endless discussions about load calculations, tensile strengths, and thermodynamic limits. You're grateful for some peace and quiet as the team of engineers tromps out of the hatch and heads for their exotic corporate retreat. You prepare for the return journey to <origin>.
units.raw: dialog "For days your ship has played host to endless discussions about load calculations, tensile strengths, and thermodynamic limits. You're grateful for some peace and quiet as the team of engineers tromps out of the hatch and heads for their exotic corporate retreat. You prepare for the return journey to <origin>."

units.english: The team's boss thanks you for a smooth trip and authorizes a payment of <payment>.
units.raw: dialog "The team's boss thanks you for a smooth trip and authorizes a payment of <payment>."

units.english: The <npc> is about to enter this system. Intercept it and make detailed scans of its cargo for Syndicate researchers on <destination>; proceed there before <date> for <payment> after retrieving the data.
units.raw: description "The <npc> is about to enter this system. Intercept it and make detailed scans of its cargo for Syndicate researchers on <destination>; proceed there before <date> for <payment> after retrieving the data."

units.english: You manage to make the requested scans of the <npc>'s cargo. Time to head to <planet>.
units.raw: dialog "You manage to make the requested scans of the <npc>'s cargo. Time to head to <planet>."

units.english: You transmit your scans and receive a hearty congratulations, as well as <payment>. "This will save us months!" you hear someone say in the background as you close the audio link.
units.raw: dialog `You transmit your scans and receive a hearty congratulations, as well as <payment>. "This will save us months!" you hear someone say in the background as you close the audio link.`

units.english: Deliver <tons> of ordinary documents to <destination>. Payment is <payment>.
units.raw: description "Deliver <tons> of ordinary documents to <destination>. Payment is <payment>."

units.english: Almost as soon as you open the cargo hatch, several silent and surprisingly well-dressed men feed the crates of documents onto a conveyor belt right next to your landing site that you hadn't noticed, where to your surprise they soon disappear into the flames of an industrial incinerator. You collect your payment of <payment>.
units.raw: dialog "Almost as soon as you open the cargo hatch, several silent and surprisingly well-dressed men feed the crates of documents onto a conveyor belt right next to your landing site that you hadn't noticed, where to your surprise they soon disappear into the flames of an industrial incinerator. You collect your payment of <payment>."

units.english: Syndicated Systems is looking for intrepid captains willing to make a difference as part of our new Green Initiative! Deliver <tons> of recyclable <commodity> to our special facility on <destination>. Payment is <payment>.
units.raw: description "Syndicated Systems is looking for intrepid captains willing to make a difference as part of our new Green Initiative! Deliver <tons> of recyclable <commodity> to our special facility on <destination>. Payment is <payment>."

units.english: You land on <planet> and drop off the exceptionally smelly shipment of <commodity> at a nondescript building, as instructed. Just as you take off, your rear camera catches sight of a burly Syndicate employee running out of the building shaking his fist. You notice that your payment of <payment> came from your contact on <origin>, not from anywhere on <planet>.
